The supplied model facts bind UrbanMode at state:UrbanMode:line:36, FinishState at state:FinishState:line:58, and a guarded UrbanMode->FinishState transition at transition:line:60 with guard R45RouteToken==21 set by exit_urban->[*] : /auto_finished_true at transition:line:50. FinishState is a leaf without outgoing transitions and is reachable.
